intro: ^LIORA: Ugh, I can't believe that mom wants me to gather herbs today of all days!
^LIORA: Today is the day I turn eighteen and can finally join The Royal Guard... and yet I'm here in the forest picking mushrooms.
^LIORA: Let's quickly get this over with.
close_book: ^LIORA: The spellbook mom gave me is pretty useful I guess. I'd be more grateful if I wasn't out here in the middle of nowhere.
^LIORA: Anyways, time to find that herb!
found_herb: ^LIORA: I finally found it! Time to head back to town.
back_to_town: ^LIORA: Alright, after I head back home I can grab my stuff and get going! Finally, I'll be leaving this rundown dump!
^LIORA: Huh? What is with the commotion? Sounds like it was coming from the gate!
go_to_gate: ^LIORA: Hey Mr. Mayor, why is everyone out here?
^WALTER: Oh if it isn't Little Liora! You haven't heard? Someone has sealed the gate to Leifdreina!
^LIORA: What! That means I can't go and join The Royal Guard! This is awful!
^WALTER: Yeah, but there's nothing we can do about it. There's a magical spell that has the gate sealed shut.
^LIORA: I bet I can do something about it! As a Royal Guard in-training, I can get the gate open again!
^WALTER: I dunno Liora, this seems a bit larger than your average problem. I've seen you rescue cats from trees and collect items from the forest but this...
^WALTER: Well okay, just don't hurt yourself. I saw three gem-looking things fly out from the gate.
^LIORA: Maybe looking closer at the seal can give me more clues.
